name: Regis Healthcare Limited
summary: Regis Healthcare Limited engages in the provision of aged care services in Australia. It provides residential aged care services, including ageing-in-place, respite care, specialist dementia care, and palliative care services through the operation of aged care homes; and day therapy services. The company also offers home care services, such as personal care, nursing, help around your home, shopping, transport, companionship, overnight sleepovers, and cooking and meal preparation, as well as home maintenance, gardening, and allied health services.
